description:
Compare latest available Weirdgloop daily price snapshots for a chosen RS3 item set. Use get_item_details for catalogue details/trends, estimate_flip for profit, or get_price_series for historical observations.

Supply one unique 1-10-entry JSON array:
- names: ["Abyssal whip","Dragon bones"]. Each name selects its first match; use lookup_item first if uncertain. Different names that resolve to one ID remain separate rows.
- itemIds: [4151,536]. Integers bypass name lookup. Do not mix arrays or pass a comma-separated string.

Rows preserve input order. Unresolved entries remain error rows, even if every lookup fails. Available timestamps/volume can be absent; snapshots for different items need not share a date. These are guide prices, not live offers or historical comparisons.

Public reads need no credentials and are uncached. HTTP defaults to 60 requests/IP/minute; honor Retry-After on 429.

itemIds.description: Grand Exchange item IDs to compare (1-10). Provide names or itemIds, not both.

names.description: Item names to compare (1-10). Provide names or itemIds, not both.
